videos.title: Apple unveils HomeView, the company's smart display built for Siri AI
videos.description:
HomeView is a touchscreen device that acts as a hub for various connected devices, as well as a personalized control center for audio and more. The device was built for Siri AI and can adapt its content and features based on which of your family members are using it by pulling data from their iPhone or iPad.

#Apple #HomeView #SmartHome

Read our full review of Apple's HomeView here: https://www.engadget.com/2285072/apple-launch-homeview-smart-display-siri-ai/
